title: The Dream Current Below the Split

features.name: healing-fence
features.desc-on-touch: The barrier between the halves is learning to be porous. You pass through it like waking from a dream into the same dream.

features.name: synchronized-dreaming
features.desc-on-touch: Both halves breathing in unison. A current flows between them that the waking world never knew existed.

features.name: the-joining-current
features.desc-on-touch: A corridor of barely-3D light where the split forgets it was ever fractured. The two are learning each other's shapes.

features.name: suture-singing
features.desc-on-touch: The scar between the halves has learned to sing. It is no longer a wound—it is an instrument.

features.name: refracted-mending
features.desc-on-touch: Light passes through the crack and becomes whole on the other side. Both halves are the same dream, now awake.

inscription: here, the two halves dream together without waking, and the fracture becomes the thing that holds them close

file.name: Manuscript_Two_Halves_Synchronized_Notations.txt
file.note: A document that lists itself twice—once from each side—describing the same moment from contradictory geometries.

exits.label: back up to where the halves dream they are whole
where the two learn to move as one
